content: Runtime configuration is DB-store-backed. PUT /api/config/values accepts a partial nested `values` object, deep-merges it with existing settings, validates it, persists it, and hot-applies the runtime config. GET returns nested values under `payload.values`; do not expect flattened dotted keys. The response may report `requires_restart`, but the runtime object is hot-applied.

Memory-dream storage should stay side-effect-free at construction time. Use MemoryDreamService.start_async/run/revert to initialize MemoryDreamStore schema asynchronously before store access, and offload direct store I/O with asyncio.to_thread in async paths.

The block-escaped-quotes rule blocks Bash commands containing backslash-escaped double quotes in inline scripts. Workaround: write scripts to a temp file using a heredoc with a single-quote delimiter, then run the file. This avoids the escaping pattern that triggers the rule. Use: cat > /tmp/fix.py << 'SCRIPT' ... SCRIPT && uv run python3 /tmp/fix.py

Task MCP coverage tests are split across tests/mcp_proxy/tools/conftest.py and focused modules: test_tasks_create_coverage.py, test_tasks_crud_coverage.py, test_tasks_lifecycle_coverage.py, test_tasks_registry_edge_cases.py, and test_tasks_schema_coverage.py.

WorkflowHookHandler dirty-file collection is intentionally lazy and cached per _evaluate_rules invocation: baseline initialization awaits the synchronous Git scan through asyncio.to_thread, while has_dirty_files and has_target_task_dirty_files trigger the same cached snapshot during off-loop condition evaluation. Ordinary hooks with an existing baseline avoid get_dirty_files_categorized entirely; project-path resolution and Git/workflow timeout budgets remain unchanged.

Dispatcher rules remain stage-native and pure: they derive current-stage state from task stages and emit actions that `dispatcher.py` executes through `StageStatesManager`. `src/gobby/dispatch/rules.py` is now the ordered rule registry and compatibility surface; predicates, action construction, and merge helpers live in `_rule_state.py`, `_rule_actions.py`, and `_rule_merge.py`.

Gobby 0.5.0 intentionally removed provider-level session summary APIs and LLMService.get_provider_for_feature. Session summaries render prompts in src/gobby/llm/prompt_rendering.py via render_summary_prompt, which preserves Jinja2 and Python format template support, then route through LLMService.call_feature(config.session_summary, ...).

Provider CLIs must not double-sandbox inside SRT: nested seatbelt fails with `sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted`, killing the provider's shell/node tools. When SRT is the enforcing boundary (launch.enforced and backend=='srt'), spawn_executor pins internal sandboxes off: codex gets `-c sandbox_mode="danger-full-access"`, claude gets `--settings '{"sandbox": {"enabled": false}}'` (CLI settings outrank user settings). Codex was the only provider whose internal sandbox is on by default; qwen/grok/droid have no default-on local sandbox and are not pinned. Codex also scrubs env for MCP-server subprocesses, so per-session UV_CACHE_DIR redirects never reach `uv run gobby mcp-server` — the sandbox policy therefore grants uv's default cache roots (~/.cache/uv, ~/Library/Caches/uv). Fixed in task #18982, commit 095a93453.

Per-chat communications session contract (task #17896, commit 1a46adcd4): IdentityManager.resolve_inbound_identity returns an IdentityResolution separating sender attribution from the effective conversation session. DMs keep external_id comms:<channel_id>:<external_user_id> and persist that session on the sender CommsIdentity. Telegram group/supergroup messages use external_id comms:<channel_id>:group:<chat_id>; the group session is effective only for the message and is not written onto the sender identity, so multiple senders share one chat context while DM links and cross-group attribution remain intact. InboundCommunications derives the group key from conversation_type plus chat_id and rejects group metadata without a stable chat_id.

Memory-dream review-vs-delete gating is prompt-only, and that is sufficient — the deterministic code-side staleness/value prior proposed in task #17206 was evaluated and rejected as unnecessary (closed wont_fix). Evidence: the #17190 prompt tightening (decision tree in src/gobby/install/shared/prompts/memory/dream.md — `review` is an uncertainty-only escape hatch; `delete` requires a citable obsolescence signal) was measured against a full sweep (run 7be75d0d, full_sweep=true, 1824 candidates, 10 pages, 0 planner errors). The 'review' bucket collapsed from 41 (old-prompt baseline run 78bc9e92) to 2, and delete verdicts each cite concrete signals (high age_days + ~0 access_count, closed task/migration, removed UI). Durable architecture/convention/preference memories all landed on keep at 0.9-0.95 confidence; nothing valuable was swept. So: do not build the deterministic prior; the prompt alone gates cleanly. A numeric self-scoring table was also explicitly rejected during #17190 as uncalibrated and JSON-parse-fragile.

During coordination bug #15065, planned daemon restarts were canceling active terminal agents because setup_signal_handlers consumed the restart shutdown marker on the first SIGTERM, then a follow-up markerless SIGTERM reported STOP and overwrote runner._shutdown_intent. Fix commit 760ea9fa5 preserves a recorded RESTART intent across later STOP intents in the same signal handler closure; regression test covers restart marker consumed then second signal without marker.

SafeExpressionEvaluator in safe_evaluator.py supports IfExp (ternary: x if cond else y) as of commit bafc3d51 (visit_IfExp). Lesson: pipeline conditions using unsupported Python AST node types fail silently (ValueError caught by should_run_step, defaulting to True), so always add test coverage for any new AST node type used in pipeline conditions.

Bundled pipeline MCP steps must pass session identity through the call_tool wrapper/ambient pipeline context, not as an inner target argument when the target schema does not accept session_id; gobby-tasks:create_task rejects an inner session_id. Agent-spawn pipeline inputs also need a non-empty model default because an empty templated string normalizes to null; wiki-research defaults to sonnet.

MCP server configs synthesized from GitHub/search import output are preview-only. Return `requires_approval` when no secrets are missing, `needs_configuration` when placeholders remain, and avoid persisting via `_add_server`; explicit add-server is the approval/persistence step. The MCP import route should broadcast `server_imported` only when the result includes a non-empty `imported` list.

Gobby web uses a tracked postinstall patch script, web/scripts/patch-tailwind-node-dep0205.mjs, to patch installed @tailwindcss/node@4.3.0 so Node registerHooks is used when available and DEP0205 warning suppression can stay removed from package scripts. The script no-ops for other versions or already-patched installs.

Task MCP tools expose workflow-branchable errors through `TaskToolErrorCode`: closed-task failures use `TASK_CLOSED`, claim conflicts use `TASK_CLAIM_CONFLICT`, and invalid stage/lifecycle operations use `TASK_INVALID_STATUS`. `build_synthetic_tool_output()` promotes direct MCP `error_code` to top-level `tool_output`, enabling workflows such as plan-adversary to branch on `tool_output.error_code`.

For gcode real-binary conformance tests in this repo, point the subprocess at the pytest PostgreSQL schema with GCODE_DATABASE_URL='<postgres_database_url>?options=-csearch_path%3D<postgres_schema>' (using '&' when the base URL already has a query). This lets /Users/josh/.gobby/bin/gcode write into the same isolated DB schema that CodeIndexStorage assertions read.

Task #17229 decomposed src/gobby/sessions/transcript_index.py by extracting persistent sidecar serialization and the bounded async index cache into src/gobby/sessions/transcript_index_sidecar.py. transcript_index.py remains the compatibility facade for public imports such as get_or_build_index, load_index_sidecar, persist_index_sidecar, clear_index_cache, INDEX_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES, and compatibility attributes including INDEX_SIDECAR_SUFFIX, _INDEX_CACHE, and _encode_adjustment_value. Sidecar logging intentionally uses logger name gobby.sessions.transcript_index so existing caplog/monkeypatch expectations remain stable after the split.

Codex interruption lifecycle: a live Codex transcript records `event_msg.turn_aborted` for the interrupted response, then records a new `event_msg.task_started` when the next user prompt begins. Gobby does not receive a native turn-end hook for `turn_aborted`, so turn-end-only digest/title rules leave sessions provisional. Task #18962 adds a Codex-only `turn_start` rule calling `build_turn_and_digest(prior_turn_only=true)`. The digest reader slices the transcript before the most recent `task_started`, advances the existing absolute pair cursor, and fails closed if no marker exists; repeated hook delivery is idempotent and the active prompt is never digested. The rule is a bundled template and becomes installed on a safe daemon restart; do not restart while active agents are running.

Reinstalling Rust binaries into ~/.gobby/bin on macOS: `cp` over the existing file keeps the inode and invalidates the kernel's cached code signature, so the next execution dies with SIGKILL (exit 137) before main. The working flow is `rm` the old binary, `cp` the new one (fresh inode), then `codesign -f -s - ~/.gobby/bin/<bin>` to ad-hoc re-sign. Probe success with `<bin> --version` (exit 0) before trusting the install.

When synchronizing bundled database records that still occupy a unique key, prefer an in-place manager update over import-then-delete: importing first can violate the unique constraint, while deleting first can lose the prior record if import fails. In the PostgreSQL hub, preserve atomicity through the current manager/update path. For soft-deleted conflicts, follow the current manager policy for resolving the stale row before creating a replacement.

Voice dependency decision: faster-whisper>=1.0.0 and chatterbox-tts are now base project dependencies, while the `voice` extra remains as an empty compatibility alias. Runtime voice health checks report missing required packages with `run uv sync` guidance and no longer auto-install packages via `uv pip install`; `gobby install --voice` only enables voice config and prints reference-audio guidance.

To merge duplicate gwiki entity concept pages, fold the loser's title into the survivor's aliases, merge its sources, excerpts, citations, and backlinks, then delete the loser and prune dead Used by entries from source digests. Case-insensitive title/alias resolution prevents future entity-link mentions from recreating the loser. Retarget path-form links manually. Do not retain an alias identical to the survivor title because it triggers duplicate_aliases lint.

Codewiki aggregate reuse keys must cover every dependency that affects the rendered page. Architecture pages use an architecture key including SystemModel plus relevant file/module/graph/leading-chunk evidence. `code/infrastructure.md` is intentionally deterministic and uses only `infrastructure:{SystemModel::digest()}`, so prompt-evidence changes do not churn it. Atomically planned curated-navigation sets must share one set-derived invalidation key and validate internal links before reuse.

Build HTTP control routes `/api/build/stop`, `/api/build/resume`, `/api/build/clean`, and `/api/build/restart` use the normalized control envelope shape `{success, result, error, error_code?}`. The CLI daemon control shim `_control_payload_from_daemon` unwraps only this envelope and treats legacy bare dict payloads as unusable fallback.

In the Skills activity UI, SkillsInstalledDetail catches rejected onSave promises, forwards the Error message through onError, and keeps the useDetailDraft draft dirty/open. SkillsTab.withSkillBusy similarly catches rejected row actions such as export and renders their Error message in the shared error banner. API action helpers should throw responseError for non-OK responses to activate these paths.

CONVENTION: plan-doc revision naming is audit-trail hygiene and applies ONLY when revising a plan AFTER its task tree has already been expanded. When that happens: copy-and-version rather than edit in place. Create `{original-name}-rev1.md` (then `-rev2.md` for subsequent revisions), prepend a change note explaining why the pivot + what the prior design was + date, and leave the original file untouched as the audit trail. Update downstream tasks' `> Plan reference:` lines to point at the latest rev. Does NOT apply during normal drafting before expansion — iterate in place on the original plan file. Rationale (user, 2026-04-21): editing the source plan in place AFTER expansion destroys the link between expanded tasks and the design they were spawned from. Applies to any `.gobby/plans/task-*-plan.md` file that has been expanded into a task tree.

Task #17483 intentionally updated /Users/josh/Projects/gobby/.coderabbit.yaml so CodeRabbit reviews the in-repo Rust workspace under crates/: Rust source path instructions cover crates/**/*.rs, Cargo manifest instructions cover **/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock remains reviewable by removing the broad !**/*.lock filter, and CodeRabbit tools explicitly enable clippy and osvScanner for Rust lint/dependency evaluation.

Epic #15741 child #15748 C language skill uses 6 references: configuration, types-and-abi, memory-and-lifetime, errors-and-resources, testing, portability-and-performance. Discovery rule require-c-skill triggers on suffixes .c, .h, .c.in, .h.in, .pc, .pc.in and exact basenames Makefile, makefile, GNUmakefile, CMakeLists.txt, meson.build, meson_options.txt, configure.ac, configure.in, Makefile.am, Makefile.in, compile_flags.txt, compile_commands.json, .clang-format, .clang-tidy, .clangd. It intentionally skips C++ suffixes .cpp/.hpp/.cc/.cxx, C# .cs, and generic package/appsettings/editorconfig/YAML files; tests pin that loaded skill csharp does not satisfy skill_loaded('c').

Task #18822 / commit d3c27dd8c added `ToolResultStore` in `gobby.storage.tool_results`. Saves use one hub transaction, run configured retention cleanup before insert, store full content, and create contiguous line-aware chunks capped by configured `chunk_chars`, including hard splits for oversized single lines. `get_slice` and `get_meta` canonicalize result IDs through `uuid.UUID` before SQL and enforce project ownership plus configured read-time TTL. `gobby.search.keyword` now registers `tool_result_chunks` for BM25 with a result_id filter and `(ordinal, id)` tie breaks, and defines the shared fixed `MAX_PG_SEARCH_QUERY_CHARS = 1_000` authority for later offload query surfaces.

Gobby monolith refactor-task convention: automatic refactor-task creation for oversized files applies only to non-test Python, TypeScript, and CSS source files: non-test `.py`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, and `.css`. Tests such as `tests/`, `test_*.py`, `*_test.py`, `*.test.ts`, `*.test.tsx`, `*.spec.ts`, and `*.spec.tsx` are excluded from automatic monolith refactor-task creation unless cleanup is explicitly requested.

As of commit 2151fbf0a in gobby, non-dry `gobby build` launch calls an idempotent guard in `src/gobby/build/lifecycle.py` that runs `build_resume` when project build automation is paused before the initial dispatcher tick, and adds a warning to the BuildResult. This keeps fresh build targets from being created while project automation remains stopped.

Recall drift contract (task #18427, commit d30f67496): `memory.digest_shadow_usefulness` is dark by default and model validation rejects enabling it unless `recall_signal_hub=true`; the legacy digest_memory_usefulness reader/field is removed. Drift has no label-source or calendar-window override. It rehydrates the shipped decision cohort, requires its evaluator_version to equal the current pairwise evaluator, and freezes source, protocol, judge model, judge config fingerprint, candidate scope, weighting regime, project scope, and weighting mode from that record. It fetches only digest-shadow requests whose constants_provenance equals the active decision_digest, so static intervals and gate baseline rows never enter the live cohort even across rollback/re-enable cycles. Fewer than 10 mixed requests returns insufficient_data; a missing/unshipped/inactive/incompatible record returns idle without reading signal rows.

Codewiki module pages after #18570 use `render_module_call_sequence`: canonical Call edges are traversed from in-page components with no in-page incoming call edge, with deterministic cyclic fallback; flat stars remain SparseEvidence and only a depth-2 chain emits. A canonical depth-2 witness is reserved before caps (8 participants, 12 messages, 2 hops), messages are ordered by call depth, output carries the static-trace disclaimer and shared `is_valid_mermaid` gate. Module builders record independent ModuleDependency and ModuleCallSequence outcomes for every page. `RENDER_VERSION_MODULE` is 21 so restored dependency and call-sequence sections regenerate together; graph edges remain outside module reuse keys.

In gobby-cli task #956, codewiki architecture and infrastructure aggregate invalidation were split: architecture pages use an architecture key that includes SystemModel plus file/module/graph/leading-chunk evidence, while `code/infrastructure.md` uses `infrastructure:{SystemModel::digest()}` only so prompt evidence changes do not churn deterministic infrastructure docs.

Telegram structured callback contract (task #18854, commit f138ccae9): gobby-communications.send_message accepts inline_keyboard rows of {text,value} plus a bounded callback TTL when session_id is present. TelegramCallbackRegistry validates at most 8 rows, 8 buttons per row, and 32 total buttons; raw values remain server-side while Telegram receives one-use cryptographically opaque callback_data tokens within the Bot API 64-byte limit. Tokens are scoped to the originating chat/topic and session, expire after 1-3600 seconds, and replays/scope mismatches resolve invalid. Telegram subscribes to callback_query updates, normalizes valid clicks as callback user messages routed back to callback_session_id, suppresses invalid/expired content before responder fan-out, and answers callback queries for polling and webhooks so the client progress indicator clears.

Agent isolation was decomposed in task #17086. `gobby.agents.isolation` is now a thin compatibility facade that re-exports the historical import surface. Implementation lives in sibling modules: `isolation_models.py` for dataclasses/ABC/branch naming, `isolation_none.py`, `isolation_worktree.py`, `isolation_clone.py`, `isolation_repair.py` for hooks/project metadata/MCP preflight helpers, `isolation_code_index.py`, and `isolation_factory.py`. Tests that patch internals should target owning modules such as `gobby.agents.isolation_worktree.repair_isolation_environment`, `gobby.agents.isolation_clone.uuid4`, or `gobby.agents.isolation_repair._copy_cli_hooks`, while public imports can continue using `gobby.agents.isolation`.

In Gobby configuration and prompt routes, prompt override reads/deletes should go through LocalPromptManager.get_override/delete_override rather than direct prompt SQL, so storage behavior stays centralized and testable.

Idle watchdogs are provider-neutral: AgentLifecycleMonitor injects WatchdogReaderRegistry, and reader selection uses session.source with AgentRun.provider fallback. IdleCheckHandler is the lifecycle facade for active-run scans, freshness/pane evaluation, timeout policy, and decision ordering. AgentAttentionTracker owns attention transitions; WatchdogTranscriptResolver owns read-only transcript-path validation, discovery, and caching; WatchdogRecoveryCoordinator owns capacity and completed-turn recovery, diagnostics, and terminal cleanup. Providers without readers retain the shared idle path and perform no transcript reads.

Task #19239 (commit e44a57178) added the read-only `gobby plans review-evidence` surface. `PlanReviewEvidenceStore.list_recent` scopes by project, optional normalized repository-relative plan path, optional live-only state, deterministic `created_at DESC, evidence_id` order, and a 1..500 bounded limit. The CLI defaults to 50, renders aligned lifecycle columns, and emits full IDs plus UTC ISO-8601 timestamps under the stable JSON envelope `{"evidence": [...]}`.

ToolCallCard treats CLI/MCP tool arguments and results as untrusted protocol payloads. In web/src/components/chat/ToolCallCard.tsx, narrow file_path through the existing stringValue helper before pathBasename/getLanguageFromPath; in ToolCallCard.helpers.ts, getToolSummary returns null for non-string file_path. Completed AskUserQuestion values are normalized by normalizeAnsweredValues, which preserves strings, joins string arrays, and JSON-serializes other values.

As of task #13905 / commit 92b13b5b6, the legacy front-half conductor surface is removed from Gobby. gobby-tasks-ops no longer exposes front_half_tick, src/gobby/mcp_proxy/tools/tasks/_front_half.py and _front_half_artifacts.py are deleted, requirements-analyst and block-front-half-on-interactive-lock are no longer active bundled definitions, and task_has_label_prefix is no longer registered in workflow condition helpers. Stage-native planning/build dispatch remains the active flow.

Post-restart plan-adversary research (#18957, commit c215f95f3) found that #9640 took 34m31s and returned 25 blockers after 19 accepted round-1 repairs. Canonical classification was 15 fixer-induced/incomplete repair findings and 10 pre-existing reviewer misses, with zero new user scope. The coverage attestation said 19 emitted/6 dismissed, but the final result added six unvalidated findings (R2-F05 and R2-F21..F25), proving coverage, parent delivery, persisted result, and termination are unbound. Highest-value fixes are an atomic server-materialized finalizer, structured repair/adjacent sweep evidence before respawn, semantic consumer and finding-overlap inventories, and a global lane budget with a frozen gcode generation. Full log: docs/research/plan-adversary-improvements.md.

Gobby daemon task #17906 removed import-time secret salt/KEK path caching. `src/gobby/storage/secrets.py` now keeps only immutable filenames (`.secret_salt`, `.secret_kek`) and resolves each operation's concrete path once through `gobby.paths.get_gobby_home()`. This allows isolated contexts to change GOBBY_HOME after module import without reading or writing another context's key material, while preserving 0600 creation/chmod behavior and the shared filenames used by pack/code-index isolation.

Gobby must not forward Claude Code OAuth environment tokens such as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` into spawned tmux agents. Claude spawned-agent authentication should use on-disk login/config discovery via HOME/XDG/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or configured provider credentials such as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; do not add persistent configuration that reintroduces OAuth-token forwarding.

Task #18823 / commit 279813442 implemented `ToolResultOffloader` in `gobby.mcp_proxy.services.result_offload`. Oversized successful MCP results are classified through `classify_raw_tool_result`, serialized in two stages, stored with `ToolResultStore`, and replaced by envelopes budgeted to `max_envelope_chars - 512`. Intent is truncated to `MAX_PG_SEARCH_QUERY_CHARS` before sanitization; BM25 match search is advisory, while persistence failures return bounded inline non-retrievable envelopes. Identity fields reuse `render_bounded_identity`, stored-tail truncation is reported honestly, and `GobbyDaemonTools.call_tool` uses the same canonical classifier for MCP error conversion. `classify_raw_tool_result` treats a direct mapping containing `error` without `success` as failed, preserving the enriched-error front-door contract. Task #19006 / commit 6d121d19b adds the final safety invariant: if fitting still exceeds the working budget, return a logged minimal valid envelope instead of raising into a successful tool call; result-match hydration now uses one bulk chunk query and restores original hit order.

Bundled agent YAML must use current AgentDefinitionBody fields: prompt is ignored by the model and should be represented as instructions, and skills must be a dictionary of named lists such as methodology: [triage-judgment], not a bare list. Bundled SKILL.md files must start with YAML frontmatter delimited by --- so SkillLoader can parse and sync them.

PUT /api/config/values (save_config_values in src/gobby/servers/routes/configuration_values.py) accepts a PARTIAL nested values object and deep-merges it with the existing config — e.g. {"values": {"ui": {"knowledge_graph_limit": 500}}} touches only that key. It validates the merged DaemonConfig, persists via config_store.set_many, and hot-applies via set_runtime_config(propagate_websocket=True) (no daemon restart needed for the runtime object, though the response says requires_restart). GET returns values NESTED under payload.values — never read flattened dotted keys off it. UI surfaces can therefore persist individual settings directly (the knowledge-graph gear panel does this for ui.knowledge_graph_limit / ui.knowledge_graph_relationship_limit, #19157).

gwiki source pages have TWO naming schemes that must be reconciled by stable identity: (1) manifest-derived digest path `knowledge/sources/src-<id>.md` via `paths::derived_markdown_path(record)`, and (2) synthesis title-slug path `knowledge/sources/<slugify(title)>.md` via `synthesis::paths::source_page_paths`. A source id is `src-<16hex content_hash>-<location-slug>` (built by `sources::render::source_id(canonical_location, content_hash)`); the content hash ROTATES on every re-fetch while the location slug is STABLE. Any identity match/dedup/link-resolution MUST key on the stable location slug (everything after the hash), NOT the full hash-prefixed id — see `compile::select::source_id_slug` and (added #17705) `synthesis::paths::source_identity_slug`. `page_matches_source_identity` originally required an exact `source_path` frontmatter match, so hash rotation (and legacy stubs lacking that frontmatter key) minted `-2` sibling stubs and left sources uncompiled. This volatile-hash-identity disease is the shared root cause behind #17705 (duplicate stubs / stuck uncompiled), #17704 defect 2 (dangling concept->source links), and #17702 (topic-compile stale hash pointers).

FIXED for links in #17704 (commit on 0.5.0): `crates/gcore/src/vault/lint.rs::source_identity_lookup_key` emits a private-keyspace stable key (`\x01source-identity\x01knowledge/sources/<slug>`) for any `knowledge/sources/src-<hex>-<slug>` PAGE (in `page_targets`) AND LINK (in `link_lookup_keys`), so a link minted against an old hash still resolves to the page under its rotated name whenever they share the location slug. Shared gcore lint => covers `gwiki lint` + `gwiki trust`/health; on-disk, no re-index. Verified live 2026-07-07 gwiki 0.8.0: session-source danglers 19 -> 0 (sessions 3e4c4a13 rotated to src-103b0fac, ec749a42 to src-efd2ef44). Does NOT change the deliberate content-addressed naming.

Pending sources are drained (marked compiled) by `gwiki upkeep` (upkeep::run reconcile step: pending sources not in any broken-entity-link cluster reconcile with no synthesis); the wiki-upkeep cron runs every 24h, so sources ingested mid-cycle are transiently pending until the next run.

On 2026-06-01, coordination task #15435 fixed a Gobby hook timeout failure mode: /api/hooks/execute no longer runs adapter.handle_native through the shared DB executor, and Stop/critical hooks now have a bounded fail-safe timeout that returns a provider-native blocking response instead of letting the CLI hook runner hit its outer timeout. Commit 71de85fa8.

Strict typing convention from #18668 and #18688: wiki cron factories expose string-returning async handlers and depend on a structural coordinator protocol with handle_write_result; MCP before-tool event builders explicitly return HookEvent. The seven active regression modules in #18688 pass standalone strict mypy without suppressions. SessionMessageProcessor tests assert current processor state because the processor no longer owns message_manager. Implemented in commit 4d1e7dfb4.

spawn_agent_impl treats model names as provider-scoped: when a call explicitly overrides an agent definition's provider to a different effective provider and omits/blank-passes model, it must not inherit agent_body.model; the selected provider should use its CLI default unless the caller supplied an explicit model.

Session storage nullable update APIs use src/gobby/storage/sessions/_update_sentinel.py: omitted UNSET values preserve existing fields, while explicit None clears them. This applies to registration/upsert title, title_source, transcript_path, git_branch, parent_session_id, bulk metadata updates, and summary fields (commit 59cec9a88, task #16476).

RuleEffect and RuleDefinitionBody in src/gobby/workflows/definitions.py use Pydantic extra='forbid'. RuleEffect requires reason for block, variable for set_variable, template for inject_context, server/tool for mcp_call, input_updates for rewrite_input, watch_paths for set_watch_paths, worktree_path for set_worktree_path, and skill for load_skill; set_permission_response and set_elicitation each require at least one payload field. observe and set_retry remain valid without optional payload fields.

Gobby web CSS architecture: Tailwind is imported only from web/src/styles/index.css; semantic Tailwind theme aliases live in web/src/styles/tailwind-theme.css; runtime design tokens live in web/src/styles/tokens.css. Chat variables.css is retained only as aliases for legacy chat token names. Use shared tokens and semantic classes rather than duplicating component-local size values.

For isolated Gobby E2E tests that exercise installed workflow rules, sync bundled content into the temporary PostgreSQL hub before starting the daemon; a daemon launched with a temporary project cwd does not install development-tree definitions automatically. Provider hook simulations must also carry the same machine_id used at session start because hook session lookup uses the composite provider/session/machine identity.

Bundled rules use individual YAML files in group subdirectories, with group identity represented by tags rather than a `group` field. Sync loads both `src/gobby/install/shared/workflows/rules` and `src/gobby/install/shared/rules`, skips all `deprecated/` subtrees, and performs orphan cleanup for removed rules.

Task #17020 added the Rules activity tab under web/src/components/activity. The tab uses useRulesTabData plus focused rules subcomponents, reuses the shared activity panel list/detail patterns, adds dirty-guarded editing and serialized copy/save mutations via useRules, and registers the tab in ActivityPanelTabs/useActivityPanel/ActivityPanel. Validation for commit 062ffc92a: web type-check, focused Vitest RulesTab/useActivityPanel/ActivityPanel tests, JS/CSS/token linting, test-quality audit, git diff --check, and web build all passed. Chrome DevTools MCP verified dark/light mobile rendering at 390x844 with 44px controls, wrapped toolbar, filter dropdown inside viewport, no horizontal overflow, and accessible row/action controls.

Gobby #14938 moved dispatcher heartbeat candidate reload and context-building helpers from `src/gobby/dispatch/dispatcher.py` into `src/gobby/dispatch/context.py`. `dispatcher.py` keeps importing and re-exporting `build_context`, `reload_candidate`, and `_field` so existing tests and monkeypatch surfaces remain compatible while the file stays below the 1,000-line source limit.

Gobby #15336 fixed Claude isolated agent spawns: _spawn_claude_terminal now builds the Claude command without the prompt, adds --mcp-config <workspace>/.mcp.json and --strict-mcp-config when the workspace MCP config exists, applies sandbox args, then appends the prompt. This prevents conflicting user/project gobby MCP scopes from hiding Gobby verdict tools in spawned Claude QA agents.

Gobby test-quality analyzer skips functions decorated as pytest fixtures (`fixture`, `pytest.fixture`, `pytest_asyncio.fixture`) during test discovery, even when their names start with `test_`. Added in task #14272 commit c6dfeb381.

P2P Agent Infrastructure: AgentCommandManager lives in src/gobby/storage/agent_commands.py. It manages parent-child session commands with lifecycle: pending → running → completed/failed/cancelled. InterSessionMessageManager now has get_undelivered_messages() and mark_delivered() for delivery tracking. LocalSessionManager.is_ancestor() walks parent_session_id chain with cycle guard. Migration v116 added message_type, metadata_json, delivered_at columns to inter_session_messages and created agent_commands table.

Task claim lifecycle state must stay synchronized between workflow state and session variables. claim_task, close_task, and create_task(claim=True) mirror task_claimed and claimed_task_id updates through SessionVariableManager, because session variables take precedence during rule evaluation. Use full UUIDs rather than truncated UUID comparisons.

As of gobby-#17331, daemon codewiki refresh is shared through `CodewikiRefreshService` in `src/gobby/code_index/codewiki_refresh.py`. The post-commit `CodewikiRefreshTrigger` only gates/debounces `wiki.codewiki_on_commit` and logs best-effort failures; nightly cron registration lives in `src/gobby/code_index/codewiki_nightly.py`, creates/reconciles one disabled-by-default system job named `gobby:codewiki-nightly:<project_id>` with handler `codewiki_nightly:<project_id>`, schedules `0 3 * * *` in host-local/configured timezone, and stores cron execution timestamps as UTC via CronJobStorage. Default output remains `<repo>/gobby-wiki`, not `<repo>/codewiki`, to match the gwiki vault migration.

Gobby docs/runbooks/postgres-rollback.md is now a PostgreSQL recovery export runbook, not a SQLite runtime rollback runbook. It documents cutover-ticket parsing, pgaudit-managed/pgaudit-file/wal-archive/none capture_kind export paths, artifact attachment, and PostgreSQL fix-forward/operator-managed restore guidance. `gobby postgres deactivate` is removed and `hub_backend=sqlite` is not a supported runtime path.

Gobby design principle: LLM-backed feature configuration is adapter-agnostic and must not assume Haiku/Sonnet/Anthropic specifically. New LLM-backed features should avoid hardcoded Anthropic model names and should be built against adapter-agnostic feature config/routing (call_feature) so they work across all CLI/ACP adapters.

Context-window resolution is source-aware: use explicit override, provider-reported runtime value, provider-owned catalog value, then the DB-backed `model_metadata` registry. If none is available, return a typed unknown (`context_length=None`, `source="unknown"`); Gobby has no generic static context-window table or sentinel fallback. Sessions must pass their concrete HubDatabase and configured overrides into resolution.

Skill-loading guidance should say `Call get_skill(name="<skill>") on gobby-skills, then continue.` Do not pass session context as an inner `get_skill` argument. `loaded_skills` is the sole runtime ledger for successful agent-visible skill loads; gobby-skills bootstrap tools are directly callable and schema-gate exempt.

Gobby's daemon-facing CLI contracts are pinned: `gcode contract --format json` must match `crates/gcode/contract/gcode.contract.json`, and `gwiki contract --format json` must match `crates/gwiki/contract/gwiki.contract.json`. Contract-adjacent changes update the JSON contract, `docs/contracts/*`, vendored daemon fixtures/drift tests, and any command-routing coverage together. `gcode codewiki` has command-level `--scope`; gwiki uses global `--project`/`--topic` and has no `--scope`. Gwiki AI routes are `auto|daemon|direct|off`, and `gwiki research` follows `docs/contracts/gwiki-research.md`.

Task #17326 removed SessionSource.GEMINI and added SessionSource.UNKNOWN plus parse_session_source() as the tolerant dynamic-source parser. Legacy persisted source='gemini' rows are relabeled by migration 295_relabel_gemini_sessions for sessions and session_stop_signals; storage read paths for tmux pane monitor, agent termination, session context, and chat lifecycle now use parse_session_source() so stale or future source values become UNKNOWN instead of raising ValueError.

## Lesson
- principle: Configuration resolution must replace every `$secret:NAME` occurrence before expanding `${ENV}` placeholders and must reject unresolved secret placeholders.
- root_cause: 
- prevention: Resolve all secret placeholders first using names limited to ASCII alphanumeric characters, `_`, `-`, and `.`, fail on unresolved placeholders, then perform environment expansion.

UX convention: All text inputs in the web UI should use Shift+Enter for newline and Enter for submit. This applies to AskUserQuestion 'Other' input, PlanApprovalBar feedback textarea, and any future text inputs. Josh confirmed this is the expected behavior pattern.

In gobby-cli task #621, codewiki ownership blame timeouts were changed from in-process Rust worker threads around `gix::Repository::blame_file` to a reapable child-process `git blame --line-porcelain` path. The helper writes stdout/stderr to temp files, uses `wait_timeout`, kills and waits on timeout, then parses porcelain author/author-mail records into `OwnershipContributor`s. Timeout regression coverage lives in `crates/gcode/src/commands/codewiki/ownership_timeout_tests.rs` and checks repeated timed-out blame runs return thread count to baseline.

Task #17403 added DB-backed unmodeled transcript observation telemetry. Schema: migration 299 creates unmodeled_observation_events occurrence guards keyed by (session_id, source, kind, name, server_name, tool_type, source_ref, sample_hash) and unmodeled_observations aggregates keyed by (source, kind, name, server_name, tool_type). Storage writer lives in src/gobby/storage/unmodeled_observations.py; ObservationTracker lives in src/gobby/sessions/observation_tracker.py and is threaded through transcript render/window/processor paths. Counts exposed by gobby observations list and /api/observations/unmodeled are retention-window distinct transcript occurrences; runner maintenance prunes stale events and recomputes affected aggregate counts.

Provider/auth boundary: Gobby supports configured generation endpoints under ai.generation.endpoints with endpoint:<name>[/<model>] selectors. Codex-backed execution, including subscription, API-key login, access tokens, auth.json/keyring/env handling, remains owned by Codex CLI/app-server. Gobby must not scrape Codex auth files, infer OpenAI API keys, or instantiate OpenAI SDK clients for Codex-backed generation.

Plan-mode resolution at semantic turn_start is surface-specific: managed web chat trusts HookEvent.metadata.chat_mode and falls back to persisted session chat_mode; terminal hooks prefer structured chat_mode, provider-native state, prompt markers, then workflow variables; terminal Codex reads the newest turn_context.payload.collaboration_mode.mode directly from raw JSONL in the workflow observer layer without transcript-package imports. Context compaction guidance uses 40%/60% thresholds below 1,000,000 tokens and 30%/40% at or above 1,000,000, with missing-window ratios using 40%/60%. Implemented by task #18356 / commit acbe12577.

In gobby-cli automated builds, a spawned Claude QA reviewer can become deadlocked in LOAD_SKILLS when server-side Gobby hooks are active but the Claude session lacks registered `mcp__gobby__*` tools. The pane shows repeated `No such tool available` for `mcp__gobby__list_mcp_servers`/`mcp__gobby__call_tool`, while stop hooks keep requiring LOAD_SKILLS. Coordinator sessions with working Gobby MCP can detect this via `get_running_agent` plus `tmux -L gobby capture-pane`, cancel the stuck run, and allow dispatcher to spawn a replacement reviewer; do not fabricate approve/reject from the interactive coordinator because review transitions are blocked by hooks.

`gobby plans validate <plan-file>` runs Plan-Coverage validation/semantic lint, resolves project context from `--project` or cwd, and runs the local indexed consumer sweep when context is available; missing context reports the sweep as skipped. Normal validation uses `include_tests=False`; `--include-tests` enables strict test-consumer checking.

In gobby-cli gcode import resolution, parser fallback imports should be stored as `UNPARSED:<text>` only after rejecting empty or multiline fallback text. The graph projection must skip `UNPARSED:` sentinel target modules so diagnostic fallbacks are not treated as real import edges.

HTTP skill imports in src/gobby/servers/routes/skills.py must call _scan_skill_install on the ParsedSkill before create_skill. The shared HTTP gate scans the full parsed surface, rejects unsafe content with 422, and fails closed with 503 when the scanner is unavailable for GitHub, ZIP, or hub sources.

Task #18825 / commit 59002e0a0 added the internal `gobby-results` registry. `search_tool_result` gates every search through canonical UUID parsing plus project/TTL-aware `ToolResultStore.get_meta`, sanitizes only after that authorization read, hydrates pg_search chunk hits, and trims matches to `max_envelope_chars - _WRAPPER_MUTATION_RESERVE`. `get_tool_result` uses the same caller project context and bounds slices to that shared working target. Unknown, expired, cross-project, and malformed IDs share the configured-retention error; invalid query/bounds fail before I/O; backend failures expose fixed bounded errors. The registry is installed only with a database and enabled offload config, and both tool names are discovery-exempt because envelopes advertise them directly.

All 18 bundled agent templates (src/gobby/install/shared/workflows/agents/*.yaml) end in an identical `terminate` step whose allowed_tools is exactly [mcp__gobby__call_tool, mcp__gobby__list_mcp_servers, mcp__gobby__list_tools, mcp__gobby__get_tool_schema] with allowed_mcp_tools [gobby-agents:end_agent_run]. That allowlist is redundant as a grant (enforcement_checks.py already lets mcp__gobby__ discovery/infrastructure tools through unconditionally); its only real effect is blocking every native tool. Do not try to add a native 'fallback' to that step: no native tool can end an agent run. The daemon-side invariant is the fix instead — WatchdogRecoveryCoordinator._complete_if_step_workflow_finished terminalizes an idle agent as a completion whenever its step workflow has already satisfied its exit_condition, and both idle-exhaustion paths (idle_check_handler max-reprompt failure and completed_turn_recovery exhaustion) consult it. The shared 'is this workflow finished' predicate is first_incomplete_step_workflow in src/gobby/workflows/step_context.py, also used by the end_agent_run guard in hooks/session_coordinator.py.

Bundled assets under src/gobby/install/shared are content-addressed by src/gobby/install/bundled_content_manifest.json. Any shared-asset edit must refresh the affected SHA-256 entry and run GOBBY_TEST_PROTECT=1 uv run pytest tests/test_build_backend.py::test_committed_bundled_content_manifest_matches_shared_tree -q.

In gobby, legacy memory cleanup/stale-audit was retired in favor of memory dream: config lives at memory.dream, MCP tools are memory_dream/status/revert, HTTP routes are /memory/dream, and the system cron is gobby:memory-dream.

SafeExpressionEvaluator intentionally excludes ast.Mult from _SAFE_BIN_OPS as of task #16686. Multiplication is rejected during AST operator dispatch before operands are evaluated, preventing unbounded string/list repetition from stalling or exhausting daemon memory.

Heartbeat stale-task recovery must acquire the task dispatch mutex before rereading ownership and stage. Use holder/by_session_id `recovery`, perform the stage transition and claim release atomically in `HubDatabase.transaction()`, and pass `preheld_mutex_run_id` so the enclosing recovery lease covers both writes.

Spawned-agent sandbox MCP read exceptions are derived only from the `mcpServers.gobby` entry. Absolute directory arguments from every other MCP server are untrusted and must never be added to spawned-agent read roots.

In `TaskSyncManager.import_from_github_issues`, imported GitHub issues must be stored with a valid Gobby task_type such as `task`; `issue` is not in `VALID_TASK_TYPES` and causes `Task.from_row` hydration failures. Preserve `github_repo` and `github_issue_number` for dedupe/update lookups instead of relying on task_type to identify GitHub-origin rows.

`gobby.storage.sessions.SessionManager` is the canonical session storage class; `LocalSessionManager` is an alias and `gobby.sessions.manager` is a deprecation shim. The canonical class preserves `get_session()` and compatibility constructor forms for old callers/tests.

Telegram reaction contract (task #18851, commit fb6f14bdb): TelegramAdapter explicitly subscribes polling/webhooks to message_reaction and message_reaction_count, normalizes per-actor old/new ReactionType lists and anonymous ReactionCount entries (whose type field contains a nested ReactionType), and assigns each update a unique platform event ID while retaining reaction_target_message_id for action routing. Inbound reaction events dedupe before action dispatch, persist as comms messages, and are ignored by the responder turn pipeline. Base/manager reaction capabilities call setMessageReaction; responder config ack_reaction transiently adds the configured emoji around a turn and clears it in finally.

User preference: workflow capabilities should remain simple to navigate and operate, with related definition concepts grouped cohesively rather than fragmented across pages. Current architecture does not support standalone step-workflow definitions; steps are owned inline by agent definitions, while rules, agents, variables, and pipelines share the workflow-definition system.

Task #14759 added packaged bundled-content integrity verification. Build backend now generates src/gobby/install/bundled_content_manifest.json from raw SHA-256 bytes of manifest-eligible files under install/shared and verifies wheels contain it. Runtime verify_bundled_integrity prefers git, falls back to the packaged manifest when git is unavailable, sets IntegrityResult.checked/source, and fail-closes gobby sync by skipping all bundled DB sync targets when neither git nor manifest verification can run. Manifest hashes intentionally remain separate from compute_definition_hash/TemplateHashCache normalized definition hashes.

Task #17404 fixed continuation restore content-block preservation: web/src/hooks/useChat/useContinuationRestore.ts now exports isContentBlock as a full 14-variant ContentBlock guard, so restored messages with document, web_search_result, resource_link, resource, audio, diff, terminal, and unknown blocks are no longer dropped by normalizeMessages. Contract tests cover all current ContentBlock variants plus actual restore preservation of document/diff/unknown blocks.

Native release checksum parsing is shared in src/gobby/install/checksums.py via parse_sha256_digest. GithubReleaseClient.download_asset fetches the per-asset .sha256 sidecar first, then uses bounded reads (16 KiB checksum, 128 MiB asset), and raises GithubAPIError on missing/invalid/mismatched checksums so bin_freshness_updater preserves the installed binary. Implemented for task #16525 in commit 9cc2d1e59.

Gobby worktree create_worktree's hooks_installed response field refers to provider-specific CLI hooks installed via install_provider_hooks(provider, worktree_path), not git hooks. If provider is omitted, install_provider_hooks returns False immediately. Git hooks for worktrees can still be active through shared repo-local core.hooksPath in the common .git/config.

The CLI service installer was decomposed in task #14741: src/gobby/cli/installers/service.py is now a thin macOS/dispatch/re-export facade, shared template/install-context helpers live in service_common.py, and Linux systemd behavior lives in service_linux.py. Tests patch service_common for shared helper globals and service_linux for systemd helper globals.

Gobby web chat PTT UI convention: the primary push-to-talk button uses a record-style `RecordIcon`, while the toolbar STT mode cycle keeps the microphone glyph. VoiceStatusBar shows `Recording...` only for active PTT capture (`voiceInputMode === 'ptt'` and `isRecording`), with `Transcribing...` taking priority and VAD preserving `Ready — speak to send` / `Listening...` copy.

Isolated gwiki smoke-test vault recipe: gwiki project scope requires a project identity file, so to test the installed ~/.gobby/bin/gwiki against a throwaway vault, create <dir>/.gobby/project.json with just {"id": "<uuid>", "name": "<name>"}, then run `gwiki init --project <dir>` (creates <dir>/wiki), and use `gwiki <cmd> --project <dir>` for ingest-file/sources/refresh/upkeep/lint etc. Use --no-ai on ingest-file to avoid AI routing — note --no-ai ingest writes ONLY the raw capture (raw/<src-id>.md) and manifest entry; it does NOT create the derived digest, so hand-seed wiki/knowledge/sources/<src-id>.md yourself for digest-dependent smoke tests (upkeep clustering, supersede/refresh cleanup). Upkeep smoke: `gwiki upkeep --project <dir> --ai off` clusters wikilink mentions from those seeded digests (min 2 mentions) into knowledge/concepts pages. Source-manifest details for smoke assertions: the manifest is NOT a JSON file — it is `<!-- gwiki-source {json} -->` marker lines in wiki/raw/INDEX.md (SourceManifest::read/index_path); record ids are the raw filename stems (raw/<src-id>.md), and `gwiki refresh` takes repeatable `--id <src-id>` flags. Discovered while fixing #17650/#17651/#17652; useful for #17653 and any future gwiki ingest work.

AgentLifecycleMonitor must maintain task-dispatch mutexes for active task-bound agent runs. Refresh an existing matching run mutex with refresh_mutex_for_run; when an active dispatcher-held run has no mutex row, restore its heartbeat mutex to prevent duplicate dispatch. Do not mask active_run_expired_lease or create mutexes for manual agents.

IdleCheckHandler capacity recovery is provider-neutral. AgentLifecycleMonitor injects a WatchdogReaderRegistry, and each idle check selects a reader from session.source with AgentRun.provider fallback. Readers own capacity-pane matching and transcript parsing; normalized snapshot signals govern completed-turn recovery and reasoning interruption is enabled only when the reader supports it. For Codex, capacity recovery still requires the exact pane signal plus structured transcript confirmation, uses bounded per-run retry budgets, suppresses duplicate errors, resets after later model output, and delegates exhaustion to centralized idle-agent failure recovery.

For gobby-cli task #557 / gwiki shared-code Falkor edge limits, the accepted configuration surface is config_store plus ~/.gobby/gcore.yaml only; do not add .env or GOBBY_* environment-variable overrides for these gwiki edge-limit settings.

Project build automation may be hard-stopped with gobby build stop or parked while enabled with next_run_at=NULL. A non-dry gobby build launch now idempotently runs build_resume before the initial dispatcher tick when automation is paused, records a warning in BuildResult, and can wake enabled parked jobs through build or startup paths.

Codex long-running shell receipt reconciliation must preserve two native transcript shapes across `write_stdin` polling: the exact `Process running with session ID <n>` header is pending correlation state, while the exact `Process exited with code <n>` header is terminal evidence. Both can follow a strict single-call `functions.exec` wrapper, not only a native `exec_command` call. Live app-server normalization must retain the raw direct-exec `contentItems` until `ExecutionChainCorrelator` validates the native envelope; otherwise pre-normalizing to `{exit_code, output}` discards the header and makes safe direct outcomes indistinguishable from spoofed structured stdout. Native direct exec accepts only the exact envelope; wrapper-correlated results may also use structured nested tool results.

Gobby’s FalkorDB installer resolves credentials from an explicit input, existing config-store SecretStore value, or a generated password; it validates the password and persists configuration only after Docker health succeeds. Managed Compose runtime resolves FalkorDB credentials from SecretStore/config-store rather than copying the password into bootstrap.yaml.

Terminal session registration enriches terminal_context with parent_create_time and parent_name from psutil for parent_pid. kill_terminal_session permits the PID SIGTERM fallback only when no tmux pane was recorded and both stored identity fields still match; any unresolved tmux kill failure returns false without signaling the PID.

Gobby 0.5.0 local auth CLI is a Click group: `gobby auth credentials [--remove]` manages web UI credentials, while `gobby auth token` reports local token path/existence, stored SHA-256 hash prefix, and file/DB agreement. `--show` reveals plaintext and `--rotate` replaces both file and `auth.api_token_hash`; help includes the exact `gobby auth token --rotate` remediation. `gobby install --auth-mode required|disabled` persists the bootstrap setting via update_bootstrap_yaml. Implemented by task #17791 in commit 1388b276c.

Agent-facing wiki artifacts refresh through the daemon's six-hour `exports` cron job. `GwikiGateway.export_pages()` runs `gwiki export pages` and `graph_artifacts()` runs file-writing `gwiki graph`; both are in `SERIALIZED_WRITE_COMMANDS`. The scheduled handler always attempts both steps, records per-step status/ok/error, returns top-level `status=degraded` with `ok=true` when exactly one step fails, and raises when both fail. The handler lives in `src/gobby/wiki/scheduled_exports.py` to keep `scheduled_jobs.py` below the 1,000-line source limit.

Agent run stale-timeout cleanup now keys off child session heartbeat (`sessions.updated_at`) before timing out long-running runs, and timeout persistence backfills `tool_calls_count` and `turns_used` from linked session stats so active work is not mislabeled as a zero-activity timeout.

Gwiki targeted-compile identity invariant: a project-scoped explicit target requires an explicit compile topic; checkpoint sources may be reused only when the requested topic matches the checkpoint's effective topic (compile state, topic-scope name, or project question). An existing explicit target must have parseable frontmatter with a non-empty title exactly matching the requested topic after trim. Write intent and synthesis_mode never bypass identity checks, and persisted compile handoffs record the effective vault-relative target plus write intent.

Pipeline CLI approval commands (`gobby pipelines approve` and `gobby pipelines reject`) should prefer the daemon HTTP routes (`/api/pipelines/approve/{token}` and `/api/pipelines/reject/{token}`) so daemon-started pipeline resumes keep the daemon's MCP/LLM-capable execution environment. Local executor fallback is only for unreachable or unhealthy daemon cases.

workflow_definitions table has FK constraint: project_id TEXT REFERENCES projects(id). PostgreSQL FK enforcement is active. Tests using project-scoped workflows must create a real project via LocalProjectManager.create() first, then use project.id as project_id. Raw path strings like '/my/project' will cause IntegrityError.

Watchdog circuit breaker state is now persisted to ~/.gobby/watchdog_state.json. The _load_state()/_save_state() methods read/write restart_times as JSON. This means the circuit breaker survives watchdog process restarts — new watchdog instances inherit previous restart counts instead of starting fresh. Tests must mock get_gobby_home during Watchdog construction to avoid loading production state. failure_threshold default changed from 3 to 5.

Gobby feature profile defaults are structured `FeatureCandidateConfig` entries in `src/gobby/config/feature_base.py`, while `default_candidates_for_profile()` still returns label strings for compatibility. As of task #17311, built-in feature defaults do not include Gemini: `feature_low` uses `claude/haiku` then `codex/gpt-5.4-mini`; `feature_mid` uses `claude/sonnet` then `codex/gpt-5.5`; `feature_high` uses `codex/gpt-5.5` with `reasoning_effort='xhigh'` then `claude/opus` with `reasoning_effort='high'`. Keep the Gemini catalog/provider alias for non-default explicit usage; do not globally rename or remove Gemini support. `delete_stale_default_feature_candidate_rows()` treats seeded `ai.generation.profile_defaults.feature_*` rows and seeded feature `.candidates` rows containing `gemini/` as stale so old default rows fall through to the Gemini-free built-ins on config load. `default_reasoning_for_profile()` returns `None` for all built-in profiles; use `candidate_labels()` for provider/model label consumers and `candidate_runtime_entries()` to resolve per-candidate reasoning fallback. FeatureDefaultConfig consumers that build text-generation requests or provider registries must normalize via these helpers instead of treating `.candidates` as `list[str]`. `LLMService._feature_request` must preserve structured `FeatureCandidateConfig` objects when building `TextGenerationRequest`; flattening with `candidate_labels()` drops per-candidate reasoning pins for feature callers such as memory KG. Text-generation candidate attempts gate `reasoning_effort` after capability binding via `PROVIDER_CAPABILITIES`: `auto`/empty normalizes to unset; `KNOWN_REASONING_EFFORTS` is the union of provider fallback efforts; unknown efforts skip the candidate even for emit-nothing providers; reasoning-capable providers skip unsupported efforts instead of stripping and running. `gobby-memory.rebuild_knowledge_graph` belongs in `EXTENDED_TIMEOUT_TOOL_NAMES` because bounded KG rebuilds can exceed the MCP proxy default 30s timeout while completing server-side.

Gobby compact_self must synchronously establish usable handoff context before sending /compact or /compress, using a valid cached summary or immediately persisted digest/transcript-tail fallback. Full LLM summary refresh is background archival work and must not gate compaction or overwrite resumed-session lifecycle state. Digest readiness has a hard 300-second daemon-side budget; on timeout, fail precisely and do not compact.

Epic #15741 language-skill child tasks use the TypeScript reference pattern: add src/gobby/install/shared/skills/<language>/SKILL.md plus references/, add tests/skills/scenarios/<language>/ scenario and harness test, add require-<language>-skill.yaml under shared workflows/rules/skill-discovery, update SKILL_DISCOVERY_RULES and condition tests in tests/workflows/test_skill_discovery_rules.py, regenerate src/gobby/install/bundled_content_manifest.json, and run focused skill parser/search, scenario, rule, ruff, test-quality, and manifest validation.

In gobby-cli codewiki (task #853), Josh decided the primary human view should move to a DeepWiki-style model: about 10-15 curated multi-section concept/narrative pages, with the existing per-file/per-symbol pages kept on disk as a grounded, linkable/searchable reference appendix. This became the design premise underlying later codewiki curated-content, diagram-injection, and verifier work (tasks #880-#907).

Web chat session_continued frames are valid only while source_session_id matches continuingSessionIdRef and the main dbSessionIdRef remains bound to that source. This prevents stale continuation responses from rebinding conversation state or localStorage after another continuation starts or the user switches conversations. Covered by task #16810 / commit 605da33fe.

In the Gobby web chat input, horizontal footer padding should be owned by the `.chat-input-footer` CSS class rather than Tailwind `px-*` utilities. Tailwind is configured with `important: true`, so utility padding can override container-query padding at the 320px chat-column floor.

In Gobby MCP call_tool wrapper code, nested wrapper keys server_name/tool_name/project_id are stripped from target arguments before dispatch, while arguments.session_id remains a target argument. Web chat default provider resolution should parse FeatureCandidateConfig objects directly with parse_feature_candidate(candidate), not str(candidate). macOS /var temp repo paths are normalized to /private/var before symlink-safe task repo validation.

Web UI lint now runs ESLint plus Stylelint via `npm run lint`. The Stylelint config at `web/.stylelintrc.cjs` loads `web/stylelint-gobby-rules.cjs`, whose custom `gobby/require-reduced-motion-reset` rule enforces a reduced-motion reset in `web/src/styles/base.css`.

Task #18970 / commit 79486d6f3 hardened agent pane monitoring. Provider-stall attention episodes now use stable classification labels and classification-derived fingerprints rather than volatile pane chrome. Prompt question inference is scoped to the bounded final 12-line excerpt and options are sorted numerically. Lifecycle attention scans can hand captured panes to the later idle pass so production avoids duplicate capture/sync; an unknown idle classification resets state and stops the recovery ladder. Stall classification resolves one manifest per pass, scans only the final 50 pane lines, and returns bounded category labels. Terminal prompt callbacks are failure-isolated. TmuxPaneMonitor paginates active runs by offset and interactive sessions by compound cursor, offloads synchronous DB reads, and passes session.source directly into interactive classification.

Gobby status now surfaces PostgreSQL hub health through the daemon admin /api/admin/status payload under the `postgres` key, collected with `gobby.cli.installers.postgres.get_postgres_status`. The shared formatter in `gobby.utils.status` renders only `dsn_host`/`dsn_db` and status fields, deliberately ignoring full DSNs to avoid leaking secrets.

Session summary git context is bounded by transcript-derived `HandoffContext.files_modified`. No-edit sessions perform no git subprocesses and omit repository status, diff, file-change, and commit inputs. Edit sessions refresh `git status` and `git log` with `-- <session paths>`, pass the same pathspecs to `get_file_changes` and `get_git_diff_summary`, and filter any carried status to those paths. This prevents concurrent editors and overlapping plan artifacts from entering another reviewer's summary or source hash.

Session project moves must allocate a fresh destination-scoped seq_num through SessionManager.move_to_project, which holds SessionSeqMutation(destination) across MAX(seq_num)+1 and the UPDATE. openai-codex 0.144.4 Python SDK launch surface (verified against openai/codex@rust-v0.144.4:sdk/python/src/openai_codex/): the distribution `openai-codex` imports as `openai_codex`, NOT `codex`; `AsyncCodex` is re-exported from `openai_codex.api` via `__init__`. `CodexClient` builds its child environment as `os.environ.copy()` then `env.update(config.env)` — an overlay that can overwrite but CANNOT delete an inherited key, so an ambient `OPENAI_API_KEY` cannot be removed from the child through the public surface. It calls `subprocess.Popen(...)` with NO `start_new_session`, so the Codex child lives in the daemon's own process group — signalling that group (os.killpg) would kill the daemon. The SDK's own `close()` does the PID-targeted escalation instead: close stdin, `terminate()`, `wait(timeout=2)`, `kill()` on failure, plus 0.5s thread joins; it is synchronous/blocking. `AsyncCodexClient` wraps the sync `CodexClient` internally and inherits all of this. `CodexConfig` fields: codex_bin, launch_args_override, config_overrides, cwd, env, client_name, client_title, client_version, experimental_api — no api_key, no base_url, and no transport/spawn hook. `codex_bin` + `launch_args_override` are the only escape hatch for owning the launch. `_proc` is private with no public pid accessor. Consequence for the subscription-SDK plan: `account()` inspection is the enforcement point for 'never run under API-key auth', not env scrubbing.

Don't extend the pattern; do migrate new credential paths to SecretStore-only.

**How to apply:**
- Resolve new hub/provider credentials exclusively through `SecretStore.get(name)`.
- If you see `os.environ.get(<API_KEY>)` in hub/auth resolution code, treat it as a bug to remove.
- Error messages for missing auth should direct users to `gobby install` or `gobby secrets set <NAME>` (value is prompted interactively — never pass it as a CLI argument; `gobby secrets set X VALUE` is not a valid invocation per `src/gobby/cli/secrets.py:44-79`).

## Lesson
- principle: A global concurrency cap is enforceable only when every producer rechecks capacity under the same lock immediately before inserting active work.
- root_cause: Heartbeat precomputed available slots outside CronRunAdmission and later inserted through plain create_run, while run_now alone used locked atomic admission.
- prevention: Route scheduled and manual cron producers through CronRunAdmission and retain a deterministic different-job interleaving test that pauses heartbeat after its early count while manual admission fills the last slot.

When the background is fixed-bright in both themes (e.g., PROVIDER_COLORS hex literals from sourceTheme.ts) or absent (inline SVG with currentColor), light-mode text becomes near-white-on-bright = invisible. Communications responder contract (task #17894, commit a24a93e20): CommunicationsManager owns CommunicationsResponder. runner_broadcasting fans every comms event to WebSocket broadcasting and the responder with independent failure isolation, including when WebSocket is disabled. Responder access is fail-closed: DMs require allow_from; groups apply group_policy (disabled|allowlist|open), groups chat-ID allowlisting, allow_from sender checks for allowlist policy, and require_mention with per-group overrides. EmbeddingBackend index state is shared across asyncio.run worker threads. Refit must build IDs, contents, and normalized embeddings in locals, then publish all fields under the instance threading lock; search and stats/content/refit readers must snapshot under the same lock so an in-flight search sees one complete old or new corpus.

Session parent updates use the typed SessionLineageMutation immediate-transaction lock. Its PostgreSQL advisory key is global (`session_lineage_mutation`) so the lineage cycle walk and parent write observe a serialized committed order across pooled connections.

PostgreSQL hub baseline bookkeeping table policy is storage-owned. Reset fixtures should import the authoritative bookkeeping-table set from the PostgreSQL hub implementation rather than duplicating it, so schema_migrations and gobby_migration_state are preserved consistently.

In Gobby gcode, use gcode symbol-at PATH:LINE or PATH:LINE:COLUMN for a known diagnostic or grep location. It returns the containing visible symbol, or the nearest visible symbol with lookup.match_kind = "nearest"; columns are 1-based byte columns. Use gcode outline then gcode symbol <full-uuid> for structural navigation.

SQLite FTS5 notes are deprecated in the current PostgreSQL hub runtime. Context-window resolution precedence is: explicit override, provider-reported value, provider-owned catalog, DB-backed model_metadata registry, then typed unknown (context_length None, source "unknown"). Sessions pass their concrete HubDatabase and configured overrides into resolution.

Validation diff shaping in src/gobby/tasks/validation_evidence.py selects omitted definition names test-first for files categorized as tests. `_added_signature_names` deduplicates matched names, stable-partitions case-insensitive `test*` definitions ahead of helpers, preserves source order within each group, and caps markers at 12 names. Gobby web `useSessionDetail` now centralizes selected-session reload and reset behavior in `loadSessionDetail()`/`resetSessionDetail()`. User-confirmed design for test typing enforcement: ship `gobby test-types audit` as a product feature using a committed occurrence-count baseline and `--fail-on-new`; tests remain a ratchet so existing global mypy debt never blocks, while new errors fail. Inbound communications voice-note contract (task #17898, commit 69c8fc057): TelegramAdapter marks normalized attachment metadata voice_note=true for Bot API voice media. In the Gobby repository, the root-anchored local `wiki/` vault is gitignored on source branches. The managed Gobby hook chain prepares or reuses a sibling `../<repo-name>-wiki` worktree on the orphan `wiki` branch, mirrors vault contents there, and publishes only when the detected default branch is pushed. The web UI has a built-in artifact system (not Claude's) at web/src/components/chat/artifacts/. It supports code, text, image, and sheet types with versioning. For Gobby/gwiki daemon-web integration, upstream `gwiki read --format json` returns command-specific JSON with Markdown `content`; read payload statuses `not_found`, `invalid_request`, and `ambiguous` are successful subprocess JSON payloads, not subprocess failures. Daemon `GwikiGateway.read` should pass exactly one selector (`--path` or `--title`), and title lookup is exact first-heading resolution until upstream intentionally expands aliases/wikilinks. Daemon attach remains mapped to `gwiki ingest-file`, with no upstream `gwiki attach` command.

Baseline bumps are reserved for destructive re-flatten or major-reset work. Session-wiki work should hook the actual summary-generation/lifecycle path, not assume `_session_end` generates summaries. Gwiki source manifest IDs incorporate canonical location and content hash, so changed synthesized content at one location requires explicit cleanup/update behavior to avoid accumulating source pages.

The set includes root _index.md, knowledge/INDEX.md, code/INDEX.md, any _context.md, and knowledge/topics/wiki-research-backlog.md with slash normalization. Structural pages remain indexed and searchable, while claim auditing and librarian near-duplicate scanning exclude them; near-duplicate scanning filters both query pages and returned semantic hits.

Project resolution mock targets: When testing CLI commands that resolve project IDs, patch gobby.cli.utils.get_project_context (not gobby.cli.tasks.crud.get_project_context), because resolve_project_ref() in cli/utils.py does the actual import. The bundled stage registry at src/gobby/install/shared/registry/stages.yaml has an active 11-stage vocabulary. Retired review-only rows adversarial_review, expansion_qa, and code_review_qa have been removed, and startup sync tests expect them to stay absent.

On 2026-07-20, active AGY-specific work was consolidated under epic #18653, “Complete AGY provider integration and transport readiness”: #15044 transport monitoring, #17169 SDK evaluation, and deferred/escalated #18381 structured command outcomes. #18576 and #18642 remain in their existing hierarchy because AGY is only an incidental reference in those tasks.

The local managed PostgreSQL status can report `missing pgcrypto` on an older existing Docker volume even though PostgreSQL is healthy. The `gobby_postgres_data` volume was created 2026-05-21, before `03-pgcrypto.sql` was added in commit 21dd21699 on 2026-07-02. Docker initdb scripts do not rerun for an existing data directory, and a daemon restart does not invoke the PostgreSQL installer. The image has pgcrypto 1.4 available and the gobby DB owner has CREATE privilege, so `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;` installs it without recreating the volume. Current baseline startup requires pg_search only, but backup restore probes require pgcrypto.

For Gobby web UI verification, prefer Playwright Core with the installed Chrome for Testing binary in headless mode. chrome-devtools MCP can be unreliable for Vite SPA loading and its window, emulation, and screenshot operations may hang on occluded or minimized windows; if it wedges, restart that MCP process. For source changes, run `npm run dev` in `web/` (Vite on port 60889); the daemon on port 60887 proxies UI/HMR in `ui.mode=auto` or `dev`. If live browser verification is unavailable, use type-check, lint, targeted component tests, and document the limitation honestly.

Three identical try/except TemplateEngine blocks were replaced with _render_template() calls.

Gemini CLI is unsupported in Gobby. Gobby storage is PostgreSQL-only. Do not reintroduce SQLite support, sqlite3 imports, gobby-hub.db references, database_path compatibility, SQLite search backends, or agent-monitoring skill references; build-coordinator is the installed skill replacing agent-monitoring.

Gobby task commit tools support explicit `project_path` for `link_commit`, `unlink_commit`, `auto_link_commits`, `get_task_diff`, and close-task commit handling, but explicit paths are allowlisted before Git helpers run. Tasks #13911 and #13912 centralize formatted logging in src/gobby/telemetry/logging.py. classify_log_surface assigns gobby.hooks to hooks; gobby.mcp, gobby.mcp_proxy, and gobby.servers.routes.mcp to mcp; gobby.scheduler, gobby.dispatch, gobby.build, gobby.system_automation, and gobby.workflows.pipeline_heartbeat to automation; remaining gobby.* to daemon. Root gobby filters give every record exactly one primary file (daemon.log, hooks.log, mcp.log, or automation.log), while WARNING+ also reaches errors.log. Automation summary logging is event-driven: idle summaries stay DEBUG; executed, cap-reached, or reason-bearing summaries use INFO. The dead in-process OTel LoggingHandler/LoggerProvider bridge remains removed while trace and meter providers remain.

Tracing scope clarified in session #9697: OTLP export is for monitoring the Gobby daemon only. Gobby will not ingest user-application spans, ship a shared application Collector setup, or add cross-service trace-context propagation as part of this change. In gobby-cli, gwiki CLI integration tests now use `crates/gwiki/tests/common/mod.rs::GwikiFixture` for owned tempdir lifetime, isolated HOME/XDG/GOBBY_WIKI_HUB setup, project/root/hub path accessors, topic initialization, JSON/success helpers, Postgres test URL lookup, and gwiki scope cleanup. Default fixture commands strip inherited Gobby/Postgres/service env; database-url helpers re-add only `GWIKI_DATABASE_URL`.

Claimed-task skill enforcement records a definitive gobby-skills get_skill `Skill not found` response in the session variable `unresolvable_required_skills`; `first_unloaded_claimed_task_required_skill` skips those names while transient or other get_skill failures remain blocking.

Plan-review consumer inventory derivation. Task #19080 (commit 6cd340828) established `build_inter_round_diff`, the deterministic `CandidateSiteInventory`, typed `inventory_unavailable`, and `settle_indexed_value`, which brackets the one preparation-owned index run so the inventory is derived from a coherent index. The index-token half of this contract is GONE as of task #19211 / commit 6a434800d. In the gobby Rust workspace (crates/), gobby-core (crates/gcore) is a shared library crate, not a standalone CLI binary. Do not install or surface it in ~/.gobby/bin alongside gcode, ghook, or gwiki unless the workspace adds a real binary target.

Task #12250 changed `ChatterboxTurboProvider.warmup()` to prime the remaining cold synthesis path after model load and reference conditioning by running one throwaway capped generation (`_WARMUP_PRIME_TEXT='warm up'`, cap `min(config_cap, 8)`) under the normal synthesis lock. Use psycopg `%s` placeholders, not `$N`.

MCP wrapper identity is ambient caller context: resolve `X-Gobby-Session-Id` first, then an allowlisted project-scoped terminal context, otherwise return `SESSION_REQUIRED`; body `session_id` remains target-tool-only. Gobby convention: do not add legacy compatibility paths or fallbacks for removed configuration keys or retired contracts unless the user explicitly requests compatibility. Use and validate the active contract directly; reject review suggestions that reintroduce legacy behavior.

Gobby web UI cleanup direction: Project, Cron Jobs, Reports, and Traces should no longer be top-level hamburger/sidebar pages. Preserve Chat page functionality, including Activity panel cron/traces/reporting-style operational views where still used, and keep shared hooks/APIs that Chat depends on.

The memory dream prompt treats a newer same-scope related memory—especially a decision that contradicts or supersedes the candidate—as citable obsolescence evidence. Delete when no residual value remains; refresh to state current truth while citing the newer memory. Only SparseEvidence triggers pass 2, which expands each member module to direct child modules/direct files; child modules are ranked by descending direct-file count with canonical name ties and the resolved stage set is capped at 10.
